responses.value: Add evening classes at the current studio first. They are fully booked with a 120-person waitlist, and two more kilns cost $30,000, against $400,000 for a second studio, while each class brings in $9,000 a year. The main risk is finding instructors fast enough to fill the new slots. The next step is to hire two instructors, add classes, and revisit a second studio if the waitlist stays long.
Update. If no more kilns fit, evening classes are out, so I'd open the second studio for the 120-person waitlist.
